name: @flyee/psc
description: A lawyer's ICP-Brasil cloud certificate behind an interface: the holder authorizes ONE at their certificate provider (a PSC) and ONE asks it to sign, never holding the key. One client for every PSC, as the ITI's DOC-ICP-17.01 specifies it (authorize with PKCE, token, certificate discovery, signature over a hash), and a fake that signs with an invented certificate, under one contract.
